name: BlackboxBench
description: A comprehensive evaluation suite for black-box adversarial attack methods, enabling comparison of attack effectiveness across models and settings.
evaluation_method: attack_success_rate (primary); also reports average queries and distortion (L2 / L_inf) under query budgets
reputation: Newer but increasingly used by robustness researchers to standardize comparisons of black‑box adversarial methods.
notes: Non‑LLM benchmark focused on model robustness; results are highly sensitive to query budgets, surrogate models and defense settings; risk of inconsistent comparisons if query/distortion constraints differ across studies.
